# Elanous

> Give it a goal — it plans, builds, verifies and merges on its own. It watches itself, understands what it sees, and heals itself. Install with one line, then `elanous doctor`.

Full text of every page: https://docs.elanous.ai/llms-full.txt

## Overview

- [What is Elanous](https://docs.elanous.ai/): Give it a goal — it plans, builds, verifies and merges on its own.

## Get started

- [Install](https://docs.elanous.ai/getting-started/install/): One-line install for macOS, Linux and Windows; bare Linux; background service.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.elanous.ai/getting-started/quickstart/): From a fresh install to your first harness run.
- [Update and uninstall](https://docs.elanous.ai/getting-started/update-and-uninstall/): Update with self-update; uninstall with one line. Your state folder is kept.
- [Recommended programs and services](https://docs.elanous.ai/getting-started/recommended-programs/): What to install next — model subscriptions, gh, Grok, Firecrawl, Chrome, Aside, Tailscale, Obsidian, voice — what each unlocks and how to set it up per OS.

## Using elanous

- [Commands you will use](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/commands/): The handful of commands that cover daily use.
- [The harness](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/harness/): say, ask and goal documents.
- [Working backwards](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/working-backwards/): Write the finished result first, then turn it into a goal the harness can prove.
- [PTY intelligence](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/pty-intelligence/): elanous drives terminals and coding agents from inside their own screens.
- [Tasks and intake](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/tasks-and-intake/): Anything you send becomes tasks — Telegram, the web app, links, YouTube, Linear — run by the harness or an agent.
- [Loop agents](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/loop-agents/): Work that repeats runs as loop agents you can list, start and stop.
- [Build a loop agent](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/build-a-loop-agent/): Write your own loop agent as a graph.
- [Plugins](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/plugins/): Skills and graphs install as plugins from a signed marketplace.
- [Build a plugin](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/build-a-plugin/): Package and publish your own plugin.
- [Sessions](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/sessions/): Conversation history, resume, and one-shot chat.
- [Design systems](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/design/): Choose one of 52 bundled design systems for a web project, check pages against it with design-lint and design-gate, and optionally draw full previews with OpenDesign.
- [The TUI](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/tui/): The 3-pane dashboard: attachments, slash commands, clipboard, terminals.
- [Put an HTML page on the web with Vercel](https://docs.elanous.ai/using-elanous/deploy-html-with-vercel/): Publish a report, note or diagram page at a public address with Vercel — setup, deploy, update, preview, own domain, noindex.

## Concepts

- [How elanous works](https://docs.elanous.ai/concepts/architecture/): Observe, reason, heal — from a sentence to a merged change.
- [Graph engineering and self-healing loops](https://docs.elanous.ai/concepts/graph-engineering/): One loop — observe, understand, heal — drawn as a graph that reshapes itself while it runs.
- [Source layout](https://docs.elanous.ai/concepts/source-layout/): Where things live in the repository.

## Models & providers

- [Providers](https://docs.elanous.ai/models/providers/): Subscriptions, API keys and OpenRouter.
- [Codex subscription (ChatGPT login)](https://docs.elanous.ai/models/codex-subscription/): Use your ChatGPT subscription instead of an API key.

## Surfaces

- [Telegram](https://docs.elanous.ai/surfaces/telegram/): Run elanous as a Telegram bot.
- [Discord voice channel](https://docs.elanous.ai/surfaces/discord/): Voice-channel round trips and voice attachments on Discord.
- [The web app (PWA)](https://docs.elanous.ai/surfaces/pwa/): Open the browser dashboard: Chat, Terminal, Vault, Settings and first-time setup.
- [Vault (Obsidian notes)](https://docs.elanous.ai/surfaces/pwa-vault/): Browse, search, edit and create Obsidian notes in the web app, and handle edits made elsewhere.
- [Terminal (web shells)](https://docs.elanous.ai/surfaces/pwa-terminal/): Open live shells on the daemon's machine from a browser, phone or tablet, attach files and ask an agent about the screen.
- [Chat (in the browser)](https://docs.elanous.ai/surfaces/pwa-chat/): Talk to elanous in the web app: sessions, spend, provider and backend, attachments, voice and meta commands.
- [Live (harness runs as they happen)](https://docs.elanous.ai/surfaces/pwa-live/): Watch harness runs stage by stage, read each decision with its reason and destination, and turn on Full show for demos and debugging.
- [Trace (follow a run to the log line)](https://docs.elanous.ai/surfaces/pwa-trace/): Narrow from every run on every machine to one decision and the exact log line behind it, with a command to find it again.

## Operations

- [Doctor](https://docs.elanous.ai/operations/doctor/): Find out what this machine still needs.
- [Running on several machines](https://docs.elanous.ai/operations/multi-machine/): Join machines into one fleet — seats move by rank, duties describe what each machine is for.

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://docs.elanous.ai/reference/configuration/): Where configuration lives and the keys you will touch.
- [CLI reference](https://docs.elanous.ai/reference/cli/): Generated from `elanous --help`.
- [External commands](https://docs.elanous.ai/reference/external-commands/): The commands elanous spawns and which capability each one gates.

## Help

- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.elanous.ai/help/troubleshooting/): Common failures and how to fix them.
- [FAQ](https://docs.elanous.ai/help/faq/): Questions people ask — each answer carries the command that re-measures it.

## Releases

- [0.2.4](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-4/): PTY intelligence stage two: elanous works inside Codex and Claude Code, installs a plugin from an agent's own menu, and passes one mission along several agents.
- [0.2.8](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-8/): Changes in 0.2.8.
- [0.2.7](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-7/): Changes in 0.2.7.
- [0.2.6](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-6/): Changes in 0.2.6.
- [0.2.5](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-5/): Changes in 0.2.5.
- [0.2.3](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-3/): A shorter command, an Approvals tab that merges, tasks from Linear and other tools, several machines as one, a lighter terminal UI.
- [0.2.2](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-2/): Daemon security hardening, one rule for which environment a command runs in, web setup for chat bots, a lighter install.
- [0.2.1](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-1/): S3: no default bucket, private/public buckets; options that are now always on.
- [0.2.0](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-2-0/): monad is now Elanous — new command, package, paths and repository; npm as elanous.
- [0.1.2](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-1-2/): Updates (elanous update --auto), release yank, fleet reduce — released as monad.
- [0.1.1](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-1-1/): Bare-Linux install fixes, pinned Bun 1.4.2, memories survive power loss and uninstall.
- [0.1.0](https://docs.elanous.ai/releases/0-1-0/): First public release (2026-09-25).
